module.purpose: Defines Vitest workspace configurations for multiple test-selection modes, including packaged embed tests, integration tests, timezone-dependent tests, and the default suite.
module.summary: This configuration module reads command-line flags and the TZ environment variable, validates timezone-specific execution, and exports a Vitest workspace definition. It routes execution through specialized workspace configurations or a broad default suite, assigning test globs, exclusions, environments, setup files, names, and API path aliases for different Cal.com areas.
module.businessContext: Supports reliable automated testing across Cal.com packages and applications. Incorrect routing can omit tests, include incompatible suites, or prevent timezone-sensitive validation.

env: Reads the TZ environment variable from process.env.
process: Reads process.argv to select the active test workspace mode.

sectionMap.name: timezone prerequisite validation
sectionMap.intent: Reject timezone-only execution when the required environment variable is absent.

sectionMap.name: workspace mode selection
sectionMap.intent: Choose a specialized or default workspace configuration from command-line flags.

sectionMap.intent: Run packaged embed tests in a jsdom environment.

sectionMap.name: integration workspace
sectionMap.intent: Run package and application integration tests with API path resolution.

sectionMap.name: duplicate integration branch
sectionMap.intent: Contains a second integration configuration after the earlier integration branch.

sectionMap.name: timezone workspace
sectionMap.intent: Run timezone-specific tests using the supplied timezone label.

sectionMap.name: default workspace suite
sectionMap.intent: Configure package, application, feature, UI, embed, and API test workspaces.

sectionMap.name: workspace export
sectionMap.intent: Pass the selected workspace list to Vitest's workspace-definition helper.

Packaged embed mode is evaluated before integration, timezone, and default modes.
Every selected workspace is passed through defineWorkspace before export.
Specialized workspaces use explicit include and exclusion patterns to isolate suites.

The process environment may provide TZ when timezone-dependent tests are requested.
process.argv and process.env are available during configuration-module evaluation.

module.moduleLevelCode: Imports defineWorkspace, reads process.argv and process.env.TZ, validates timezone mode, constructs workspaces through nested conditional expressions, and exports the Vitest workspace definition.
